components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary command for product actions such as create report, publish announcement, or save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.625rem); background: var(--primary, #ff5533); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #ff5533) 90%, #000 10%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #ff5533) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Neutral secondary command for export, cancel, filter, and non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ece7e4); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.625rem); background: var(--background, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f9f9f9); color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #ff5533) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Compact form and filter input used across auth, settings, candidates, and announcements.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input { height: 32px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--input, #ece7e4); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.625rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #767676); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #ff5533); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #ff5533) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Elevated summary card for dashboard metrics and high-level status only.
components.html: Total applicants646Across 3 batches
components.css: .ds-metric-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-3xl, 1.375rem); background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--card-foreground, #1b1b1b); padding: 12px; box-shadow: rgba(4, 23, 43, 0.05) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0 20px 25px -5px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0 8px 10px -6px; } .ds-metric-label { color: #6b5549; font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric-value { color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); font: 700 36px/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-metric-note { color: #6b5549; font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Primary Badge
components.description: Compact pill for counts, roles, statuses, and unread markers.
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; width: fit-content; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #ff5533); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sidebar Menu Item
components.description: Compact left navigation item with icon, label, hover, and active state.
components.html: Candidates
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.5rem); color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #1b1b1b); background: transparent; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-sidebar-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover, .ds-sidebar-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #fff1ed); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #8d1600); } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring, #ff5533); }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Compact segmented control for settings sections, filters, and view modes.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; width: fit-content; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.625rem); background: var(--muted, #f9f9f9); color: var(--muted-foreground, #555555); } .ds-tab { height: 26px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.5rem); background: transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #1b1b1b) 60%, transparent); padding: 0 8px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #1b1b1b); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #ff5533) 45%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
SUN.RISER Dashboard is a product UI system for daily recruitment work. It uses a restrained light canvas, high-contrast ink, and a rare SUN orange accent to keep candidate review, scheduling, announcements, and admin work clear under repeated use.

The current identity is this Impeccable design system: Geist-backed, compact, shadcn-first, and task-focused. DESIGN.md, .impeccable/design.json, src/app/globals.css, src/styles/themes.css, and shared primitives in src/components/ui/ are the current source of visual truth. The legacy material/ design files are archival references only and should not drive new UI decisions.

This system rejects landing-page drama, generic SaaS decoration, heavy glass effects, and novelty controls. The product should feel calm around sensitive candidate data while still carrying enough warmth to belong to SUN Studio.
keyCharacteristics: Light canvas with restrained contrast layers.
SUN orange for primary actions, selection, focus, and status emphasis.
Compact density for tables, filters, drawers, and admin flows.
Familiar shadcn primitives with lucide icons and Base UI behavior.
Motion used for state feedback, not page choreography.
Optional glass themes exist as appearance modes, not the baseline identity.

rules.name: The Orange Rarity Rule
rules.body: SUN orange is for action, current selection, and state. If it is used as decoration, remove it.

rules.name: The Mock Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use neutral or informational treatments when data is mock, local, or device-bound. Do not use confident success styling for temporary client state.

rules.name: The Glass Is Optional Rule
rules.body: Glass orange and glass blue are theme variants. The default design language is solid, readable, and restrained.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Product UI uses Geist across headings, buttons, labels, and data. Do not introduce display fonts into workspace controls.

rules.name: The Compact Heading Rule
rules.body: Product headings stay fixed-size and readable. Do not use fluid hero typography inside workspace surfaces.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Name Rule
rules.body: Names, universities, roles, and candidate messages may be long and multilingual. Layout must truncate or wrap intentionally.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: In dense product UI, start with a warm border or tonal background. Add shadow only when depth changes the user's understanding.

rules.name: The No Ghost Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not pair a decorative 1px border with a wide soft shadow on ordinary cards or buttons.

dos: Do use #FF5533 for primary actions, selected states, active controls, progress, and state emphasis.
Do use #FCFCFC and #FFFFFF as the default workspace canvas and surface pair.
Do use #1B1B1B for primary text and keep muted text at readable contrast.
Do use shared src/components/ui/ primitives for buttons, inputs, checkboxes, dialogs, tabs, tables, tooltips, sidebars, and popovers.
Do keep workspace spacing compact: page padding around 12px to 24px, card padding around 12px to 16px, and section gaps around 16px.
Do show mock, local, pending, syncing, and permission states explicitly.
Do preserve Vietnamese text, long names, long URLs, and mixed-language candidate messages without overflow.
Do use lucide icons inside icon buttons and action buttons when an icon clarifies the command.
donts: Don't treat the workspace like a landing page, campaign page, or SaaS marketing dashboard.
Don't use oversized hero layouts, promotional stat blocks, or decorative feature-card grids in product surfaces.
Don't use gradient text, colored side-stripe card accents, decorative stripe backgrounds, or generic AI dashboard ornament.
Don't make glassmorphism the default visual language. Existing glass themes are optional appearance modes, not the baseline product identity.
Don't overplay the game-industry context with playful UI if it slows candidate review.
Don't drift into dark terminal, finance cockpit, or heavy enterprise admin aesthetics unless a specific workflow requires it.
Don't invent unfamiliar controls for standard actions like filtering, sorting, selecting rows, editing records, opening details, or confirming destructive actions.
Don't imply that mock, local, or device-bound data is durable server data.
Don't introduce new font families into product controls.
Don't use display-scale typography inside compact dashboard cards, settings panels, drawers, or table controls.
Don't pair a decorative 1px border with a wide soft shadow on ordinary product containers.
